_comment: LLM Wiki Daemon — reference only. Copy the relevant block into your harness config; do not put tokens in this file or in the vault.

dsh_headless._note: Verified 2026-11-15. dsh-mcp-client supports streamable-http directly, so NO stdio bridge is needed. Tools are exposed as mcp__llm_wiki__<tool>. The headless app reads its provider credential from the launching environment; no credential value is stored in this repo. Session contract is delivered via MCP `instructions` on initialize — no global stub needed.
dsh_headless._credential_env: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY — read from the launching environment at runtime; never stored in this repo, in the vault, or in any config file
dsh_headless._addressing: All tools except vault_create take `target` (an Obsidian wikilink such as [[Note]]); `path` is a legacy alias. vault_create.path is the location of the NEW page. vault_patch uses `part` (frontmatter|section|end), not `target`, for the part to change.

with_token_example._comment: Set LLM_WIKI_DAEMON_TOKEN in your shell, then add this header.
